title: AVECOINS
description: Introduces a variety of material-based coins that can be used as currency within your world or server.
body: ![AVECOINS Banner](https://i.imgur.com/XDtlnXu.png) Welcome to the AVECOINS mod, a lightweight currency system that adds five material‑based coins to your Minecraft world or server. Perfect for survival economies, server shops, or just as a decorative collectible, **AVECOINS** brings a simple yet elegant coin system with full crafting support and informative tooltips.   # **ENGLISH & SPANISH LANGUAGE** 📚 The mod is available in English, Spanish and Mexican Spanish! Just download the mod and enjoy the tooltips and names in your **preferred language**.   [![Banner Kinetic Hosting](https://i.imgur.com/WzP8oN5.png)](https://billing.kinetichosting.com/aff.php?aff=1208) 🌐 Kinetic Hosting is proudly sponsoring this mod! Start your adventure with friends and dive into the full server experience. Enjoy a smooth, reliable, and secure hosting experience powered by Kinetic Hosting.   # **DESCRIPTION** **AVECOINS** adds five tiers of coins, each with its own material and colour: 🔸 **Copper Coin** – the foundation of the economy. ![Copper Coin](https://i.imgur.com/P5rwAqJ.png) 🔹 **Iron Coin** – sturdy and reliable. ![Iron Coin](https://i.imgur.com/e9opPtO.png)   🟡 **Gold Coin** – lustrous and rare. ![Gold Coin](https://i.imgur.com/71tWKXu.png) 💎 **Diamond Coin** – precious and valuable. ![Diamond Coin](https://i.imgur.com/DUjZpQE.png)   ⚫ **Netherite Coin** – the ultimate tier. ![Netherite Coin](https://i.imgur.com/46rCk31.png)   ***   # **⚙️ CRAFTING SYSTEM** Upgrading and downgrading coins is simple and well balanced. **Note:** There is currently no survival method to obtain these coins. If there is enough requests, a survival-friendly way may be added in the future. For now, the base **Copper Coin** can only be obtained through Creative mode. I highly recommend using an NPC mod to set up coin-based trading shops. Upgrade recipe (shaped): 4 lower‑tier coins + 1 ingot/gem → 1 higher‑tier coin. ![Crafting Method](https://i.imgur.com/Tgo9NpR.png) Reverse recipe (shapeless): 1 higher‑tier coin → 4 lower‑tier coins. ![Downgrade Crafting Method](https://i.imgur.com/nAsJrqC.png)   ***   # **🙌 CREDITS** * **Author**: SundGGs * Built with [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/) for Minecraft 1.21.1 * Inspired by basic economy mods and the need for a clean, server‑friendly currency. **Enjoy your new coin economy!**
